title: STNFS v7: sub-bin yield integration (caps 4x/1.5x), re-searched lazy descent, shared Krylov 4+3 overhead, blocks (28, 5): 120.1532361703

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm of proof.md, DESCENT.md and STORAGE.md returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P (Q=[a]Q0 from two GT logarithms; z=1 handled directly) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, and all classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^120.1532361703 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions); upper-rounded ledger rows sum to 2^120.153236170299471. Relation collection is unchanged from v5/v6 (9ff4fc85, 9332a74d): excess 1.1, theta=2330/8000 sub-region of the 164,000-draw pool on theta=5/16, retained relations >= 2^63.6617 (0.0728 bits = 2.00 pool SE above 1.1 U), 99.9% ECM, X2=2^64, slacks (295, 226), band strip, f-first early abort, allowance 1.0174: <= 2^119.929654705 units. Linear algebra: Markowitz merge to weight 300 (charged 301 per row; N(300)/N(100) charged 0.711 >= measured maxima 0.690-0.710 at 2^12..2^18), N = 0.711 x 1.066 x 0.05797 U = 2^58.9429 < 8 x 2^56 (eight owners, row tail counted 1,424, charged 1,430), Block Wiedemann (28, 5) with 128-bit X entries; the five Krylov sequences share each pass over the matrix (krylov5.s: 39 instructions per +-1 entry for five vectors, 33 per vector for other entries) and v7 charges the inherited 4+3 per entry once per +-1 entry and per vector for other entries: 0.88 x (4+3+39)/5 + 0.12 x (4+3+33) = 12.896, charged 12.9 per vector-entry; Horner products at 20.7 per entry, 97 per dense term, 420 per reduction, 60 per projection term: <= 2^117.279842877 units; generator <= 2^107.806519571. Descent (v7): node and boot yields integrate the measured norm offsets over 24 / 10 sub-cells, capped at 4x / 1.5x the sextile-maximum yield, so the unit-duplicate campaign's E[shat/m] >= 4.70 / 1.06 x the sextile yield gives >= 1.175 / 0.7067 x the charged yield, above UDUP 0.65; the 62-node plan and boot (215, 328, 16, 4) are re-searched at these yields, THIN_MAX 85, with v6's lazy evaluation (sieve nodes cofactor survivors in uniformly random order and stop at the first relation whose subtree succeeds, expected fraction processed <= E_M min(1, (1+1/s)/((1-psi)(M+1)) + psi^M), M negative binomial as in the failure model, checked against a simulation; the boot finds and descends one relation at a time, at most 18). Expected two-log work <= 2^112.2596; meter 2^112.975291; Markov abort <= 0.6089135; boot failure 3.258e-06 per log, expected nodes 2^15.49, node abort 2^-11.81, repeats 2^-10.70, 2/r charged. Preprocessing, failures, transfers, verification and output are included; nothing amortized; memory at most 2^105 bytes. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, nonzero lower/upper integration controls, and the lazy-cofactorisation bound against a simulation. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger (recentred kernels, early abort, weight-300 LA with five-vector Krylov kernels (v7 shared 4+3), sub-bin yields, eight-owner row tail), retention, ECM, lazy descent (with a simulation of the lazy process) and declared bounds (about 105 s natively; longer when emulated).
